| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `muted_or_invalid` | Tx output signal muted or invalid |
| 0x01 | `valid` | Tx output signal valid |

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `not_recalled` | Settings are not recalled |
| 0x01 | `from_buffer_1` | Settings have been recalled from recall buffer 1 |
| 0x02 | `from_buffer_2` | Settings have been recalled from recall buffer 2 |
| 0x03 | `reserved` | Reserved |

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `not_recalled` | Settings are not recalled |
| 0x01 | `from_buffer_1` | Settings have been recalled from recall buffer 1 |
| 0x02 | `from_buffer_2` | Settings have been recalled from recall buffer 2 |
| 0x03 | `reserved` | Reserved |
